title: Uniformly bounded derived towers with pro-zero cohomology are pro-zero
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], with derived category $D(\mathcal A)$ and cohomology functors $H^q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $X_n\in D(\mathcal A)$ for $n\geq1$ and let $t_{k,n}:X_k\to X_n$ for $k\geq n$ satisfy $t_{n,n}=\mathrm{id}$ and $t_{\ell,n}=t_{k,n}\circ t_{\ell,k}$ for $\ell\geq k\geq n$. Suppose there are fixed integers $a\leq b$ such that $H^q(X_n)=0$ for every $n$ and every $q\notin[a,b]$. Suppose also that for each integer $q$ and each $n\geq1$ there exists $k\geq n$ with $H^q(t_{k,n})=0$. Then for each $n\geq1$ there exists $k\geq n$ with $t_{k,n}=0$ in $D(\mathcal A)$.
